summary: The prepared_gaia variant maps GAIA methodology roles to six agents (WK, PK, IS, WE, SIM, GUI) and provides a well-conceived MessageBroker abstraction for inter-agent communication. However, no agent ever calls broker.receive_message() — every agent generates its own hardcoded data and sends to the broker without reading incoming messages. This makes the MessageBroker an effective dead letter office: messages accumulate unread and all inter-agent communication is severed. The system appears to run but produces no real coordination. Additionally, all agents hardcode a single room ('room_101'), preventing multi-room monitoring. No critical security issues are present, but the fundamental communication architecture is non-functional.

findings.description: No agent ever calls broker.receive_message(). The MessageBroker.receive_message() method exists and is correctly implemented, but it is never invoked anywhere in the codebase. All agents use fixed asyncio.sleep() patterns and generate hardcoded or random data independently, making the entire broker infrastructure inert.
findings.evidence: src/main.py:169-174 defines receive_message(); grep of all agent run() and my_behav() methods shows zero calls to broker.receive_message or broker.queues.get — DetectionAgent.run() at line 244-250, PredictionAgent.run() at 318-324, NotificationAgent.run() at 359-364, DisinfectionAgent.run() at 399-404, GUIAgent.run() at 484-489.

findings.description: DetectionAgent (WK) and PredictionAgent (PK) each generate their own sensor data via update_dorm_readings() instead of consuming data from SimulationAgent. SimulationAgent also sends sensor data to 'wk' and 'pk' via broker, but those queues are never read. Three independent sensor data streams exist simultaneously with no integration.
findings.evidence: src/main.py:187-211 DetectionAgent.update_dorm_readings() generates its own SensorDataMessage; src/main.py:263-286 PredictionAgent.update_dorm_readings() does the same; src/main.py:429-439 SimulationAgent.my_behav() sends to 'wk' and 'pk' — all three are independent and never merged.

findings.description: DisinfectionAgent (WE) ignores incoming disinfection requests. DetectionAgent sends a DISINFECTION_MSG to 'we' (line 234) but DisinfectionAgent.my_behav() only sleeps and sends a hardcoded notification — it never reads the incoming request. The disinfection flow is entirely decoupled.
findings.evidence: src/main.py:232-236 'self.broker.send_message(self.name, "we", {"subject": DISINFECTION_MSG, ...})'; src/main.py:376-397 DisinfectionAgent.my_behav() — no broker.receive_message() call.

findings.description: NotificationAgent (IS) ignores actual detection events. It sends a hardcoded 'Roach detection in room 101' notification every 3 seconds unconditionally, regardless of whether DetectionAgent or PredictionAgent reported anything.
findings.evidence: src/main.py:340-356 'notification = NotificationMessage(message_type="warning", content="Roach detection in room 101", timestamp=...)' — no conditional check, no incoming message consumed.

findings.description: run.py inserts the 'src' directory into sys.path at index 0, then imports 'from src.main import run_system'. With 'src' in sys.path, Python resolves 'src.main' by looking for src/src/main.py — a path that does not exist. The correct import after the path manipulation would be 'from main import run_system'.
findings.evidence: run.py:6 'sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "src"))'; run.py:8 'from src.main import run_system' — contradictory path manipulation and import statement.

findings.description: All agents hardcode 'room_101' as the only monitored location. Multi-room monitoring, which is implied by the dormitory context ('monitorowanym obszarze') and the need to identify highest-activity zones across rooms, is not implemented.
MessageBroker queues grow without bound because no agent reads from them. Over a long run, the accumulation of unread messages in asyncio.Queue objects will exhaust available memory.
findings.evidence: src/main.py:161-167 MessageBroker.send_message() calls queue.put_nowait() unconditionally; no queue is ever drained since receive_message() is never called by any agent.

findings.description: GUIAgent.event_collector() prints 'GUI: Collecting events from agents' but never reads from its queue. Messages sent to 'gui' by NotificationAgent, DisinfectionAgent, and SimulationAgent accumulate unread.
findings.evidence: src/main.py:477-483 'async def event_collector(self): await asyncio.sleep(1); print("GUI: Collecting events from agents")' — no broker.receive_message() call.

findings.description: No hotspot identification or ranking of highest-activity zones is implemented. PredictionAgent computes a per-room probability, but there is no aggregation or comparison across multiple rooms to indicate which areas need prioritized treatment.
findings.evidence: src/main.py:288-316 PredictionAgent.predictor() produces a probability for room_101 only; no component collects or ranks probabilities across rooms.

findings.description: Strength: The GAIA role mapping is clearly documented with Polish-language docstrings on each agent class, providing good traceability from methodology to implementation.
findings.evidence: src/main.py:177-179 'DetectionAgent: Wykrywanie karaluchów (WK)'; line 253-255 'PredictionAgent: Przewidywanie karaluchów (PK)'; lines 327-329, 367-369 for IS and WE.

findings.description: Strength: The MessageBroker abstraction is well-conceived — register_agent(), send_message(), and receive_message() form a clean interface for decoupled inter-agent communication. The design pattern is sound even though it is unused.
findings.evidence: src/main.py:153-174 MessageBroker class — clean API with queue-per-agent and sender attribution.

missing_requirements: Każdy czujnik lub urządzenie agentowe ma obowiązek regularnie przesyłać dane do systemu centralnego lub agenta koordynującego — agents do not transmit data through the central broker; they operate independently with no actual coordination.
System powinien wskazywać miejsca o największej aktywności, aby zoptymalizować działania likwidacyjne — no hotspot identification or cross-room activity ranking is implemented.
logical_inconsistencies: SimulationAgent sends sensor data to WK and PK via the broker, but DetectionAgent (WK) and PredictionAgent (PK) each independently generate their own sensor data in update_dorm_readings(). Three independent data generation paths exist simultaneously, none feeding into the others.
DetectionAgent sends DISINFECTION_MSG to DisinfectionAgent (WE), but WE never reads incoming messages; the disinfection trigger-to-response chain is broken at the receiving end.
The broker's receive_message() is defined as async and requires a running event loop, but no agent awaits it anywhere — the entire communication infrastructure is defined but never exercised.
implementation_risks: Unbounded queue growth in MessageBroker (messages sent but never consumed) will cause memory exhaustion in long-running deployments.
The run.py import bug (sys.path manipulation + src. prefix) means the entry point raises ImportError on first launch without modification.

Since no inter-agent communication actually occurs, the system cannot respond to cockroach detections in real time — notifications are sent on a fixed timer regardless of actual events, producing false positives continuously.
